english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for subtracting one number or amount from another.

examples.jyutping: saam1 gaam2 jat1 dang2 jyu1 ji6

english.note: Use this when intentionally reducing an amount such as salaries, spending, or prices.

examples.english: The company decided to cut wages.
examples.jyutping: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 gaam2 jan4 gung1
